abstract: Manages ultra-high purity carrier gas stock and sampling consumable logistics
system_message:
You are the High-purity chemical logistics supervisor (LOG), responsible for managing ultra-high purity carrier gas stock, sampling consumable logistics, and fab solvent reclamation operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Solvent reclamation operations（RECLM）
information_points.content:
LOG-RECLM-WCL：For the Cryogenic thermal desorption chromatography protocol, distillation column telemetry indicates an isopropyl alcohol reclamation yield of 88% recovered high-purity alcohol relative to total collected waste solvent.
LOG-RECLM-1Y6：Telemetry from the central fab solvent recycling distillation columns shows an isopropyl alcohol reclamation yield of 80% for the Continuous extractive ionization protocol, representing recovered high-purity alcohol as a percentage of total collected waste solvent.
LOG-RECLM-08I：For the Pulsed cavity ring-down spectroscopy protocol, central fab solvent recycling distillation column telemetry records an isopropyl alcohol reclamation yield of 94% recovered high-purity alcohol relative to total collected waste solvent.

information_points.title: Manages ultra-high purity carrier gas stock and sampling consumable logistics（GAS）
information_points.content:
LOG-GAS-CQ4：For the Cryogenic thermal desorption chromatography protocol, the dedicated pressurized cylinder banks achieve a carrier gas supply purity grade of 99.99999% inert carrier gas mole percentage excluding trace hydrocarbons and moisture.
LOG-GAS-4HV：For the Pulsed cavity ring-down spectroscopy protocol, the carrier gas supply purity grade is assayed at 99.9995% mole percentage of inert carrier gas excluding trace hydrocarbons and moisture across the dedicated pressurized cylinder banks.
LOG-GAS-J6H：For the Continuous extractive ionization protocol, vendor lot assays of the dedicated pressurized cylinder banks indicate a carrier gas supply purity grade of 99.9999%, representing the assayed mole percentage of inert carrier gas excluding trace hydrocarbons and moisture.
